title: Dubračina Valley G-LIM: technical validation code
description: Code for the quality control and technical validation of the geomorphological landslide inventory map (G-LIM) of the Dubračina Valley, Croatia, described in Jagodnik, Fiorucci, Bernat Gazibara & Santangelo, Geomorphological landslide inventory of the Dubračina Valley using pseudo-stereoscopic LiDAR hillshade maps, Scientific Data (2026). Every number in the Technical Validation section of the paper is produced by these scripts from the published inventory (doi:10.5281/zenodo.22814494).

creators.name: Santangelo, Michele
creators.affiliation: CNR-GEO, National Research Council of Italy, Institute of Geosciences
